sources.title: Dog Breed Info — Cock-A-Chon definition and keeper submissions
sources.evidence: Fresh page read: original named adult submissions describe Bichon/Cocker crosses; definition specifies American Cocker while independent kennel uses broader Cocker. Card retains Cocker Spaniel without asserting universal subtype. Individual character and inherited traits excluded.
